note: READABLE SOURCE REFERENCE ONLY. This is not an oracle. Parity is measured against test/fixtures/package.json (yjs-stable=13.6.32, yjs-preview=14.0.0-16 via npm), never against these clones. These clones exist so a person can read upstream source to explain a conformance result. Each row's `sha` MUST match the corresponding oracle pin exactly so the source read is the source that ran.

refs.purpose: readable Rust reference implementation (yrs) that docs/plans/2026-03-07-yjs-port.md ports against; no executable oracle exists for this one today, so this row is the only version fact for it. Pinned to the v0.25.0 release tag (matching the version= string in y-crdt/{yrs,yffi,ywasm}/Cargo.toml) rather than to a later commit on main, so the sha a reader sees is unambiguously citable as "v0.25.0".
